name: DS18B20 1-Wire temperature sensor (TO-92)
description: Digital temperature sensor, -55 to 125 C, several on one data wire.
notes: Flat face towards you, legs down: GND, DQ, VDD left to right. Reversed VDD/GND makes it hot and kills it.
Supply 3.0-5.5 V; power it from the same voltage as the microcontroller logic so DQ stays at a safe level.
DQ needs a 4.7 kOhm pull-up resistor to VDD (not built in). Waterproof probe versions: red = VDD, black = GND, yellow = DQ (check).
Many cheap DS18B20 are clones with slightly different behaviour.
